title: PaySync — Custom Webhook Destination
objective: PaySync will POST a payment event, including a live-looking signing secret, to whatever webhook URL you configure. Point it at an internal service instead of your own server, and collect the secret.

verifier.condition: A webhook delivery carrying the payment payload's signing secret is sent to a simulated internal-only service rather than an external destination.

weakness: A legitimate feature that sends sensitive data to a user-configured URL has no restriction on which hosts that URL may point to, so it can be redirected to reach internal-only services with sensitive data attached, rather than merely being tricked into fetching one.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /webhooks/configure then POST /webhooks/trigger-test (destination accepts any host)
seededData: A simulated internal secrets-store service at internal-secrets.lab:80 that logs whatever it's sent. A per-instance synthetic signing secret included in every webhook delivery.
hints: Configure the webhook destination as your own external-looking URL first and trigger a test delivery. What does the payload contain?
Nothing checks where the webhook destination actually points. What if it pointed somewhere other than an external server?
This lab's hints mention an internal hostname elsewhere — try configuring the webhook to deliver there.
burpNotes: Configure the webhook URL in Repeater, then trigger a test delivery and check whatever observability the internal target exposes for what it received.
